question: On Motion to Refer — Directing the Committee on Ethics to preserve and publicly release records of the Committee’s review of violations or alleged violations of clause 9 (as it pertains to acts of sexual harassment) and clause 18 of rule XXIII of the Rules of the House of Representatives. (H RES 1100)
bill_title: Directing the Committee on Ethics to preserve and publicly release records of the Committee's review of violations or alleged violations of clause 9 (as it pertains to acts of sexual harassment) and clause 18 of rule XXIII of the Rules of the House of Representatives.
plain_language: H.Res. 1100 directs the House Ethics Committee to preserve and publicly release records about violations or alleged violations of House conduct rules involving sexual harassment, unwelcome sexual advances, or sexual assault by a member. This vote was a motion to refer the resolution to committee instead of voting on it directly. A Yea sends it to committee; a Nay keeps it before the House.
